description: This file defines structures, function prototypes, and constants for managing angel connections and calls within the lighttpd server, including callback types, error enums, and API functions for creating, freeing, and sending data over angel connections.

classes.name: liAngelConnection
classes.description: Represents a connection for angel communication, including socket info, callback handlers, and input parsing state.

classes.name: liAngelCall
classes.description: Represents an ongoing angel call, including context, callback, and result data.

methods.name: li_angel_connection_new
methods.description: Creates a new angel connection with specified event loop, file descriptor, and callbacks.

methods.name: li_angel_connection_free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with an angel connection.

methods.name: li_angel_call_new
methods.description: Creates a new angel call with specified event loop, callback, and timeout.

methods.name: li_angel_call_free
methods.description: Cancels and frees an angel call if possible.

methods.name: li_angel_send_simple_call
methods.description: Sends a simple call with specified module, action, and data.

methods.name: li_angel_send_call
methods.description: Sends a call with specified module, action, data, and associated angel call object.

methods.name: li_angel_send_result
methods.description: Sends the result of a call, including error, data, and file descriptors.

methods.name: li_angel_cleanup_tables
methods.description: Cleans up temporary memory used by the angel connection.
